messages:
ira: quick sync — post-launch micro-iteration. three follow-ons: (1) bigclient vectors stale causing search regressions, (2) chat p95 surge after batching tweak, (3) small token UI copy awkward. need owners and final priorities.

ben: paste the bigclient ticket?

lia: BIGCLIENT-22: "search returns older vectors intermittently since compaction change". customer impact: partial degraded search for high-value users.

omar: infra: we saw compaction concurrency increase at 2026-03-28 01:20 UTC; logs show "kv_compact_race" warnings. plausible cause.

hana: token copy is tiny. 2-3 hrs design, 2 dev hrs. good quick-win for self-serve.

ira: my call: BIGCLIENT-22 = P0 hotfix (rollback compaction parallelism + reconcile), p95 chat = P1 (triage + pause experiment if linked), token copy = P3 next sprint. agree?

ben: I can own hotfix. plan: revert flag, add one-shot reconcile job that reindexes recent writes and a smoke replay of customer trace. est 1.5 dev days. need SRE for canary.

omar: I’ll run staging repro, prepare 5% canary and rollback playbook. will capture kv metrics and set smoke checks.

release-bot: Branch created hotfix/bigclient-reconcile-1899999999. CI: passed. (automated)

lia: success criteria: recall back to baseline for 24h, no stale-vector alerts for 48h, customer confirmation before full ramp.

ben: opening PR now with reconcile script + replay harness.

omar: after canary I’ll replay chat load to see if p95 correlation exists; if yes, we revert batching thresholds temporarily.

ira: decision log: BIGCLIENT-22 P0 (ben+omar), chat p95 P1 (ben), token copy P3 (hana). canary tonight 22:00 UTC; 9am PT check tomorrow. i'll update roadmap notes.

ben: :thumbsup:
